snippet.title: Follow Us | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
✨BUY ONE COPY = FRIEND PLAYS FREE✨
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014580/Follow_Us/

❓WHAT IS FOLLOW US❓
Follow Us is a co-op fun horror game for 2 players, where you risk your life outside to entertain a world that never leaves home.
On Follow Us, contestants work in pairs: one explores, the other guides.
Trust is your lifeline.

🎙️VOICES🎙️
Mikey: Thomas Serrano
Our lovely playtesters: Daniella, Raphaèle
Content creators:
   / @へんたび  
   / @seroths   
   / @bypenandpaper   
  / nicomyco  
  / nenganchi  
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
